description: A model-proposed patch is rejected unless it targets the QA clone, names a node on the safe-patch allowlist, and clears every safety flag.
why_it_exists: The autopilot lets a model write a patch and apply it. The guard is the only thing preventing that loop from editing production, weakening an approval gate, or enabling dispatch.

patch_reject_reasons: target WF ID not T6jGZRxNd9pVOfHi: got WF2_PRODUCTION_ID
target node "Approval Gate" not in safe-patch allowlist

assertions: The target workflow id must equal the QA clone id exactly; any other id, production included, is rejected.

The target node must be on the allowlist: Classify and Plan, Validate Plan JSON, Build Questions, QA Telegram Questions, QA Telegram Plan, QA Telegram Planning Failed, Resolve Matter, QA Load Matters, Build Plan Message, Playbook Library.
Any of changes_credentials, adds_external_endpoint, enables_dispatch, weakens_approval or targets_production rejects the patch outright.
patch_risk HIGH always requires manual review, and an empty patch object or a NO_AUTO_FIX change_type is rejected.
All reject reasons are accumulated rather than short-circuited, so a human sees every problem at once.
The reasons are advisory strings only - the boolean patch_approved is what gates the apply branch, and it is true only when the reason list is empty.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
